description: Timer switch with freely adjustable schedule. The block outputs a state (active/inactive) and an analog value based on the current schedule entry.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Digital output: active (true) when schedule entry is on, inactive (false) when off or no entry

outputs.name: Value
outputs.description: Analog output: value from the current schedule entry

config.name: Schedule
config.description: Schedule to use for time-based activation

state.name: Last execution timestamp
state.description: Last execution timestamp in seconds from epoch

state.name: Next execution timestamp
state.description: Next execution timestamp in seconds from epoch
